title: LPIC-1 Foundations: Organize and Find Files

items.skill: Locate and inspect representative configuration, log and personal files; introductory FHS practice.
Create a directory tree and finish in the intended workspace.
Make a content-preserving working copy using no-clobber behavior.
Move and rename a regular file, preserving its contents.
Use bounded find to discover a matching file, then read the discovered path.
Combine creation, copying, cleanup, discovery and final verification.
